name: ESO 383-G76 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 383-G76, the giant central galaxy of the cluster Abell 3571, seen by Hubble.
label: eso383g076-hubble
story: This is the dominant galaxy at the heart of Abell 3571, a cluster that belongs to the Shapley Supercluster. Its center holds an unusually large, flat core of stars, the kind of core astronomers think surrounds an exceptionally massive black hole.

claims.text: ESO 383-G76 is the brightest cluster galaxy (BCG) of Abell 3571
ESO 383-G76 (A3571-BCG) is a cD galaxy in Abell 3571, imaged by Hubble ACS in program GO-10429
ESO 383-G76 has a large, flat (depleted) core, and the paper concludes that large-core galaxies harbor overmassive supermassive black holes
Abell 3571 is a member of the Shapley Supercluster
A3571-BCG is another designation used for ESO 383-G76
